title: I made a free multiplayer .io brawler based on Animal Farm: ram your rivals and become Napoleon
author: NoDecision9007
selftext:
Hey all! I've been working on **Who Is Napoleon?**, a browser game inspired by Orwell's *Animal Farm*.

You pick a farm animal (chicken, sheep, horse, cow, duck or pig, each with its own perk) and ram the others into the electric fence, the pond or the incinerator. Grow heavy, take the podium, and you're crowned Napoleon. Every 40 seconds Napoleon rewrites the farm's rules, like taxing everyone's weight or letting Mr. Jones's tractor loose. The goal is to hold the crown as long as you can while the whole farm tries to overthrow you.

There's also a 5-minute team mode (Foxwood vs Pinchfield) and private rooms to play with friends.

[https://ramthefarm.com](https://ramthefarm.com)

happy playing
